newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin impatient to have heart operation - wife.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin impatient to have heart operation - wife.

text.p: Boris Yeltsin is impatient to have his heart operation as soon as possible, his wife told Russian television on Thursday, but said she could not give a date for the surgery.
Naina Yeltsin said the president, who announced on September 5 that doctors had recommended the operation, was frustrated at not being able to work flat out.

"He suffers because he cannot work at full force, that is a full working day from morning to night. But in the first half of the day he is practically always busy, whether it be on the telephone or with meetings and whatever," she said.
"In general we do try to draw him away from this but he practically never listens to anyone," she told Russian public television.
Asked about Yeltsin's heart surgery, which doctors have said will take place next month, Naina said that he wanted to get it over with as soon as possible.

"Boris Nikolayevich would like it quickly quickly quickly, that's a natural wish. But I cannot give a date or anything, I don't know," said Naina, who herself left hospital only last week after a kidney operation in August.

Doctors had previously cited problems with the quality of Yeltsin's blood but his spokesman Sergei Yastrzhembsky said on Thursday that doctors were satisfied with his condition and that preparations for the operation were going according to plan.
